subject: CamtrapR reads the image metadata - can I do the reverse? I.e. write to the image.

messages.author: 9c3183af58028473
messages.subject: CamtrapR reads the image metadata - can I do the reverse? I.e. write to the image.
parts:
Jürgen

At the moment I use ExifPro to add metadata (species and station) to the image which I then read into camtrapR.  I am really grateful for that successful workflow.

But I am wondering if I can use camtrapR (and its use of ExifTools) to write back additional (or corrected metadata) to the original image? I like the idea of the image, the source data, containing the attributes.  Can I write an R function (in camptrapR so I benefit from camtrapR's use of ExifTools) that will do this?

David

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: CamtrapR reads the image metadata - can I do the reverse? I.e. write to the image.
parts:
Hi David,
I'm sorry, this function is currently not implemented in camtrapR and I have not worked on any code to make it possible for arbitrary tags. There's only the function addCopyrightTag() to add copyright tags. The code of that function can easily be adapted. 

Alternatively, you could use exiftool directly. See the website for some simple examples. 

https://owl.phy.queensu.ca/~phil/exiftool/examples.html

Let us know how it goes.
Cheers,
Jürgen
